notes.title: May update 2.0.1 - Continuation of the story.
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32670804/d5b3c3c4eae929a303f605a45c39ef00be754669.png
May update 2.0.1 - Continuation of the story.

*Fixed a problem with the game cursor
*We decided to change the system prompts and dialogs to a completely new one. We do not know how it will behave in the game, but we expect that you will like it.
*We also added new sound effects and minor changes to the animation. We recommend wearing headphones before the game.
*And many minor fixes are waiting for you in the game!

* To work, delete the old version of the game and install a new one!

Thank you for your criticism and support!

Regards EyesbergGame

notes.title: Winter Update 2.0 - Already in the game
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32670804/957550f0e514a96e92a3c37063f82e598cda53d6.jpg
Changes in update 2.0:
- Added support for all screen resolutions (previously, the maximum resolution was 1366x768)
- We reviewed the plot of the game and brought it to mind
- Added new level
- New sounds and music (old songs are not affected)
- Changed the dialogues
- Added new effects
- All sprites in HD

And other fixes are already in the game!

- For the update to work, remove the game and install

This is the latest major update for Mad Frost. We are currently working on the next project. Please leave your feedback to the game! It is very important to us!

We also want to congratulate you on the upcoming holidays! Successes and fulfillment of desires! May the next year bring you only positive emotions.

Regards EyesbergGame

notes.title: Update 1.4.2. - Saving - is already in the game.
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32670804/4c1a4ef5c04d7e0dbb79e34810553f3e21a4188e.jpg
We got your wish to have a system of saving in our game. So in a new update 1.4.2 we have corrected this issue. 

Press the button "SAVE" and you will save your progress, but! Be ready to start the current level ( not the whole game) anew. There are many reasons why we did so, one of them is "a short game story". 

We have also added Steam Cloud support and corrected some mistakes. 

Thank you so much for your support.
Best regards, EyesbergGame.

notes.title: Update 1.4 - Is already in the game
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32670804/cbf3772b7d56cf1f92474538ba4ecdc7902273c7.jpg
Some of the main changes in the update 1.4
- solve a puzzle in the episode "Fridge" and get into a new episode of our Mad Frost world. 
- some levels are visually improved.
- some new objects are added.
- some physical characteristics of objects are improved ( "Power" )
- some language issues in the English version are corrected. 
- some new hints are added ( in the final fight as well) 
- some mistakes are corrected.

We try to follow your suggestions and wishes. But due to the lack of time we can't do everything at once. So a new huge update 2.0 is coming soon. 

What's there in the update 2.0:
- the system of savings and checkpoints.
- improved gameplay mechanics of all levels. 
- new puzzles
- a new level

Thank you for your support! It is very important for us! 

Best regards EyesbergGame.

notes.title: Mad Frost - update 1.3.1
notes.content:
ALREADY AVALIABLE
The update 1.3.1 description:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32670804/10e3e39bf5a9945b4a227e7427d1026a5d3646b8.jpg
 - A new level has been added. 
- The second variant of finishing the game (sad) has been added.
- New achievements have been added.
- Dialogue windows have been corrected ( no timer now, you can switch them off in one click) 
- Some physical characteristics of objects has been corrected ( "your favourite" fish for example)
- Limits of sprites have been corrected ( it is hardly possible to fall through textures) 
- Some other corrections have been done. 

We tried to be attentive to every offer, opinion and advice of yours. This is the first update of our project. In the next update you are going to get some more benefits such as a system of checkpoints and a choice of levels in the main menu. 

Thank you for your support. We are happy to work for you. 
Best regards, EyesbergGame.

notes.title: Mad Frost & Unity 2018
notes.content:
After "Unity 17.3" has been updated to "18", some graphic artifacts appeared. 

One of the mistakes - light 
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32670804/242b43967f09e9a1daea296e879b2200c77d1d41.jpg
At the moment we are in the process of making our project suitable for the new version of Unity. We correct all possible mistakes and hope in the final version there won't be any of them. Possibly we are to postpone the date of the release. 

Thank you for your attention. Best regards, EyesbergGame.

notes.title: Mad Frost - Update 1.3
notes.content:
Welcome to the world of Mad Frost
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32670804/594ff0e3931f6f495fc3185e5d40a6b4400c7bca.jpg
Everyone who knows our project from the very start, remembers those mistakes that used to appear in the earlier versions of the game. By the 1.3 version we have corrected everything successfully.
Our important changes include:
- The total change of graphics, we added hd quality sprites and new effects. 
- The correction of (almost) each animation.
- The correction of old locations. Now you won't fall "into the unknown" all of a sudden. 
- The game has been translated into English and Russian. 
- New soundtrack composed with love has been added. 
- The system of achievements works correctly. Try to get them all!
Plus a lot of other significant improvements.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32670804/7012d74d36c7631f8e7adf03e6af29b57eed8a21.jpg

The trailer has been made in a rush, just to be on time. It is going to be remastered. The story turned out short, but it isn't bad! As some new ideas are looking forward to appearing soon! 

Thank you for your great support! We need it so much! 

Best regards, EyesbergGame.
